task.head: 16a54f0f85a9091f220418850eac6b4122782be5
task.title: fix: guard against ReDoS via user-controlled regex in custom rules engine
task.body:
## Summary

- Reject patterns longer than 1 000 characters in `CustomRulesEngine.validatePattern()`, preventing oversized regex from reaching the engine
- Allowlist regex flags to `gimsuy` characters only in `validatePattern()`, blocking invalid or dangerous flag strings
- Strip disallowed flag characters at `executePattern()` runtime as a defense-in-depth measure for rules loaded directly from `.techdebtrc.json` (bypassing `validatePattern`)
- Export `MAX_CODE_LENGTH` (500 000) from `customRulesEngine.ts` and enforce it in `parseExecuteCustomRulesInput()` to cap the inline `code` parameter, preventing an unbounded string from being fed through every custom rule regex
- Update `CHANGELOG.md` with the security fix entry

Closes #127

## Test plan
- [x] `validatePattern` rejects patterns > 1 000 chars with a descriptive error
- [x] `validatePattern` accepts patterns exactly at the 1 000-char boundary
- [x] `validatePattern` rejects flags containing any character outside `gimsuy`
- [x] `validatePattern` accepts all six valid flag characters (`gimsuy`)
- [x] `executePattern` strips disallowed flags at runtime without throwing, still matches correctly
- [x] `parseExecuteCustomRulesInput` throws `McpError` when `code` exceeds 500 000 characters
- [x] `parseExecuteCustomRulesInput` accepts `code` exactly at the 500 000-character limit
- [x] All 538 existing tests continue to pass
- [x] TypeScript build succeeds (`npm run build`)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
